instrument.perpetual: BitMEX XBTUSD (INVERSE: margined and settled in BTC)

interpretation_limits: Each refinement of resolution found a WORSE number: 0.138% (Hyperliquid 4h), 0.45% (BitMEX 1h), 2.74% (BitMEX 1m). Nothing establishes that one minute is fine enough.
2020-03-13 could not be measured because BitMEX had minutes with NO TRADES. That is the venue ceasing to function, which is the tail appearing as absence. No basis number captures it.
The two worst excursions are from 2019 and 2021; 2020 and 2022 are far tighter. The basis has compressed as the market matured, so the bound may be REGIME-DEPENDENT rather than structural.
XBTUSD is INVERSE: margin is BTC, so a crash erodes the collateral backing the short. The liquidation translation is worse than the basis suggests.
Six years without venue failure says nothing about the case where the venue fails, which is a risk the basis does not express.
measurement: carry adverse basis excursion at 1-minute resolution

excursion.note: adverse means the perpetual trading ABOVE spot; a liquidation cascade drives it below and is favourable to a carry

selection_criterion: The six largest single-day UPWARD spot moves in BTC-USD over 2019-2024, chosen independently of the basis so days are not selected for having behaved badly. A cash-and-carry loses when the perpetual pulls ABOVE spot, which happens when leveraged SHORTS are liquidated -- a squeeze follows a violent rally, not a crash.
